physicalNotes: Radius: 1.756 +/- 0.071 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius (Ehrenreich et al. 2020, Nature 580, 597; arXiv:2003.05528, Extended Data Table 1, from their ESPRESSO spectra and the Gaia DR2 parallax). GM from their stellar mass 1.458 +/- 0.021 solar masses (same table) times the JPL solar GM 132712440041.93938 km^3/s^2. The star has a bound companion, WASP-76 B, 0.44 arcsec away and about ten times fainter (same paper, Methods); it is not placed. presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the star's spin axis is not measured in three dimensions (Ehrenreich et al. 2020 measure only its sky-projected angle to the orbit, 61 degrees).
